title: DESIGN.md is the design entry point, with supplements only when needed
context: ADR-0108 makes a single root document the design authority and the sidecar a generated artifact. Detailed guidance may eventually make every agent read material irrelevant to its task. Mandatory splitting would add navigation and maintenance cost while the document is still small.
decision: Root DESIGN.md is the authoritative entry point for the design system. Keep the rules in that file while it remains concise. Split a topic only when its detail creates a meaningful reading burden and can be loaded independently; DESIGN.md must identify each supplement, its scope, and when to read it. The entry point and its explicitly referenced supplements together own the rules, without duplicate editable definitions. .impeccable/design.json remains a committed generated artifact derived from those sources, not an independent authority. Blueprint presents the authoritative sources and live samples; docs/design-system.md is migrated and deleted.

alternatives.option: Require every rule and detail to remain in one file
alternatives.reason: As the document grows, agents must load unrelated details for narrow tasks.

alternatives.option: Split every topic into a supplement immediately
alternatives.reason: Adds indirection and maintenance cost without reducing a demonstrated reading burden.

alternatives.option: Author additional rules only in the sidecar
alternatives.reason: Makes the generated artifact a second editable authority.

consequences: Agents read DESIGN.md first and load only the supplements required by its reading instructions and their task.
Markdown links are references, not automatic imports; conditional reading instructions must be explicit.
The sidecar must be regenerated from the authoritative sources when they change.
